portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Cross-sectional outcomes are widely dispersed, although the supplied aggregate dispersion statistic is missing and Ethereum is an extreme outlier. Weak payrolls coexist with solid spending, strong services orders, elevated prices and a tightening Fed. This favors selective rather than broad reversal exposure. Oil has independent supply evidence supporting a rebound; technology leadership lacks comparable briefing support. The October inflation releases, FOMC meeting and November employment report can materially change relative returns before exit.
